estado.descricao: When active, it proposes hypotheses about the team anchored in real events, and each one waits for you to accept or dismiss.
estado.pausadoDescricao: No session is analyzed until it is reactivated. When active, it proposes hypotheses about the team anchored in real events, and each one waits for you to accept or dismiss.
estado.reativarExplicacao: The pause is a team decision. To turn it back on, whoever operates the installation sets PSYCHOLOGIST_ENABLED=true in the engine and restarts it. Hypotheses already issued do not change; new analyses will spend budget again.

exemplo.observacao: "The PO declares open questions the Creative had already answered in the brief."
exemplo.sugestao: Suggestion: include the full brief in the PO's context. Accepting creates a versioned instruction patch, which is a ceiling: only you apply it.
